# Ramp CLI

`GRADED` `WRITES-DIRECT`

Ramp's own command-line tool for its developer API, built for agents: expenses, bills, reimbursements, requests, cards and travel. Can sign in read-only.

**What it can do:** Changes records without asking first.

## Why these badges

- **`WRITES-DIRECT`** — Commands include bills approve, reimbursements approve, requests approve and transactions edit. A read-only sign-in is available (ramp auth login --read-only).
